title: Toyota Fortuner Legender's third price hike of 2026 (10 Nov): up to ₹48,000; ex-showroom now ₹43.35 lakh (4x2 AT), ₹45.53 lakh (4x4 MT), ₹48.77 lakh (4x4 mild-hybrid AT, Neo Drive); after the 8 Jan (+₹71,000) and 6 May (+₹83,000) hikes, the top variant is ₹2.02 lakh dearer than its 2025 price of ₹46.75 lakh
